note: Judged 2026-09-30. Positive TestRFC905LSPPlacesXAtNAndYAtNPlus1: LSP.WriteTo stores the independently derived X at octet n and Y at n+1 (X != Y guarded, so a swap cannot pass) and the decoded LSP verifies. Negative TestRFC905LSPWithSwappedXYRefused: the same LSP with the two octets swapped is refused by LSP.VerifyChecksum, the check the flooding path runs, while the unswapped one is accepted. Records on lsp.go::WriteTo and VerifyChecksum, observed red.
